here is no school on Saturday. It is a cloudy autumn
day. Autumn is usually a beautiful season in Salem.

Mr and Mrs Connor have a big orange pumpkin. They

Halloween?”

“No, Dad. We must find a place for the party,” says Kelly.

“We must make our costumes ' too,” says Megan.

“Today is a perfect day to do many things,” says Mrs Connor.
“Finish your homework this morning. Then you can look for a
place for the party this afternoon.”

“1 can start my science homework,” says Megan.

“1 must study English,” says Kelly. “I have a test on

the phone rings.

“Hello! This is Bill. I have a place for our party.”

“This is the oldest cemetery in Salem,” says Bill. They enter

“Look at the dates on the tombstones. ? This one says

“These are probably the tombstones of the Salem witches,”
